text: 1. Have the nationality of the countries along the "the Belt and Road", hold a valid foreign ordinary passport, be friendly to China, and be healthy.2. Have good conduct, abide by laws and regulations, be diligent and eager to learn, and have no record of illegal or criminal activities.3. Applicants must have a degree equivalent to that of a Chinese high school graduate and be under the age of 25 (students under the age of 18 must provide a power of attorney and other materials from their legal guardian).
